library(readxl)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
file_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "5 groups")
set_list <- list(
  A = na.omit(df$A) |> as.character(),
  B = na.omit(df$B) |> as.character(),
  C = na.omit(df$C) |> as.character(),
  D = na.omit(df$D) |> as.character(),
  E = na.omit(df$E) |> as.character()
)
cat("Set sizes:\n")
print(sapply(set_list, length))
cat("\nTotal unique elements across all sets:", length(Reduce(union, set_list)), "\n")

library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
gg <- ggVennDiagram(
  set_list, label_alpha = 0, label_color = "black",
  label_size = 3.2, label_percent_digit = 1
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE2E4", high = "#9D0208") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey30","grey30","grey30","grey30","grey30")) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_reverse()
out_path <- "proportional_venn_5sets.png"
png(out_path, width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 220)
print(gg)
dev.off()
cat("Saved:", out_path, "\n")
cat("File size (bytes):", file.size(out_path), "\n")
